name: workqueue-presence
description: Presence: the first deadline at create, beat by the principal the instance stands for and no other, miss applied once and only past the deadline, onMissed only from its from states and onBeat back, the runner's sweep on the engine clock, the guard on principalField, the leases a miss expires on the releaseLeases schemas through Lease's expireHolder, sparing the ones renewed since the last beat and recording the rest, the codes its refusals carry, and the config rules. Real SQLite, a real engine, a clock the tests move.

scenarios.name: Presence: beat and miss (node) > a create sets the first deadline one ttl on, so a worker that never beats is missed; Presence's fields show it
Presence: beat and miss (node) > only the principal the instance stands for can beat it

error.message: behavior Presence vetoes beat of Worker w1: it stands for another principal, who alone may beat it

details.reason: it stands for another principal, who alone may beat it

scenarios.name: Presence: beat and miss (node) > miss acts once, and only past the deadline: it sets missed and onMissed moves the status
Presence: beat and miss (node) > onMissed moves the status only from its from states: a stopped worker stays stopped
Presence: beat and miss (node) > a beat recovers a missed worker: missed clears, the deadline moves, and onBeat moves the status back only from its from states
Presence: beat and miss (node) > without onMissed and onBeat, a miss and a beat leave the status, and Workflow is not needed
Presence: the sweep (node) > the runner's schedule misses each worker past its deadline once, on the engine clock, every sweepMs
Presence: the sweep (node) > a miss that fails fails the run, which the runner retries and shows, and leaves the worker as it was

schedules.error: forbidden: runner may not move Worker w1 from idle to missing: the transition needs permission workers.mark

scenarios.name: Presence: releaseLeases (node) > a miss expires every lease the worker's principal holds on the releaseLeases schemas, through Lease's expireHolder, and no other
Presence: releaseLeases (node) > a miss spares a lease its holder renewed after the worker's last beat, and records the ones it expired in its event
Presence: releaseLeases (node) > a miss leaves the leases while another instance that stands for the same principal is present, and expires them when that one is missed too
Presence: releaseLeases (node) > without Lease's overridePermission the runner's miss fails: nothing is missed or released, and the status shows why

schedules.error: forbidden: runner may not expire the leases of a holder on Job: it needs permission jobs.override
